review_method: Line-by-line static source review, syntax compilation without execution, dependency and all family artifact hashes checked.
nonblocking_limits: Changing worker-limit from 2 to 1 delays future starts; it does not terminate a currently active second worker. This matches the planned initial 1 then increase to 2.
A partial/non-integer worker-limit write causes a safe fail-closed exception and active-worker cleanup; use an atomic replace when updating the limit.
The 1000 MiB address-space cap applies to solver children. The validator has a 120-second timeout and no controller-imposed address-space cap.
Signals or the sentinel during synchronous validation are handled after validation returns or its timeout. Solver peers have already been stopped.
The runner does not install a parent-death signal. Uncatchable controller termination cannot run finally; ordinary SIGTERM/SIGINT and Python exceptions clean up active solver groups.
Exit 20 remains an uncertified local-neighborhood outcome. A SAT candidate requires validator_exit=0, meets_posted_gate_limit=true, and Lean verification before any proof claim.
scope: Only candidate neighborhoods. No global or assigned-shard exhaustion and no Lean theorem acceptance asserted.
